protocol: At each new origin, mature previous targets, evaluate frozen earlier proposals, then choose future forecasts. Candidate library fixed before results. Final selection requires positive online skill against drift.
origin_note: 15 weekly origins from July 15 through October 21, following starter range July 15 to October 24 inclusive.

rule.study: retrospective follow-up designed after observing original undercoverage; not external holdout
rule.maturity_rule: prior origin_date < current origin_date AND target_date < current origin_date
rule.fallback: first qualifying pool; if none leave unchanged (including first origin)
rule.window: all matured prior original online forecasts; never recalibrated residuals
rule.tuning: one fixed rule; no search or adjustment after observing calibrated results
rule.bootstrap: 2000 paired whole-origin resamples, seed 42; descriptive dependence caveat

calibration_study.chronology_note: Rule fixed in results/calibration_study/rule.json before the first calibrated scoring run. Copied unchanged into config.json after first scoring results and the user requested this location; not a claim config.json preceded results.
